title: Documents into answers.
name: AI Document Search
description: A PDF question-answering tool that combines semantic search with retrieval-augmented generation.
detail: Retrieves relevant document passages before generating answers. Built as a PDF RAG chatbot with an API layer.

title: A second pair of eyes.
name: AI Code Review
description: An LLM-powered pull-request review bot that brings automated feedback into the GitHub workflow.
detail: Integrates the GitHub API and Actions with an LLM review service, retaining review history in PostgreSQL.

title: An assistant that remembers.
name: AI Agent with Memory
description: A custom assistant with session state and semantic memory across conversations.
detail: Combines LangChain and LangGraph orchestration with FastAPI, Redis session state, and ChromaDB semantic memory.

title: Making value measurable.
name: Construction Permit Valuation
description: Regularized regression for valuation across more than 5,000 construction permits.
detail: Applied regularized regression to predict permit values, reducing RMSE by 15%, and communicated results through Power BI.

title: Better signals. Better predictions.
name: Heart Disease Prediction
description: A classification pipeline built around careful data preparation and cross-validation.
detail: Combined SQL/Python workflows, SMOTE, and a cross-validated Random Forest. ROC-AUC increased from 0.81 to 0.89 against a logistic regression baseline.

name: Maternal Birthweight Analysis
title: Birth-weight patterns, carefully examined.
description: Report-aligned analysis of 1,236 birth records using imputation, EDA, t-tests, chi-square, and ANOVA.
detail: Reconstructed SAS source reproduces the report’s headline statistics in independent checks: one-sample p=0.002416, smoking-group Welch t=8.6398, smoking–parity p=0.753378, and age-group ANOVA p=0.538677. Collaborative work with Devadharshini Udayakumar and Prithwiraj Chatterjee. SAS execution is pending. Observational associations do not establish causation.
imageAlt: Maternal Birthweight Analysis — independently calculated result figure

name: Sleep Treatment Response
title: Measuring a paired response.
description: Paired inference and planning curves for drug and placebo sleep measurements in 10 participants.
detail: Mean paired increase: 1.72 hours; 95% CI 0.481–2.959; two-sided p=0.01192. Includes normality checks, a placebo benchmark comparison, and a corrected power-planning model. Results independently checked; SAS execution pending.
imageAlt: Sleep Treatment Response — independently calculated result figure

name: Melanoma Lifetime Comparison
title: Comparing observed lifetimes.
description: Mean observed-time comparison across two nodule-severity groups, with explicit censoring limitations.
detail: 417 observations grouped as nodule categories 1–2 versus 3–4. One-sided Welch t=3.4955, p=0.0002693. The original analysis assumes observed times are true lifetimes and ignores censoring; this is not a censoring-aware survival analysis. SAS execution pending.
imageAlt: Melanoma Lifetime Comparison — independently calculated result figure

name: Survey Response Association
title: From counts to association.
description: Contingency tables and relative-risk estimation for 27,802 aggregate survey responses.
detail: Uses expected-count diagnostics, Pearson chi-square, conditional proportions, and explicitly ordered relative risk. Female/Male affirmative-response RR=2.7556 (95% CI 2.6695–2.8445). Association is not causation. SAS execution pending.
imageAlt: Survey Response Association — independently calculated result figure

name: Ratings Distribution Analysis
title: Understanding categorical patterns.
description: Marginal, joint, and conditional rating distributions from 18 supplied observations.
detail: Correctly oriented conditional tables estimate ratings within recorded gender categories. Personal names and row identifiers are omitted. Small-sample descriptive analysis with independently checked counts; SAS execution pending.
imageAlt: Ratings Distribution Analysis — independently calculated result figure

name: Tuition Trend Analysis
title: Tracing tuition over time.
description: SAS workflow for tuition distributions, five-number summaries, regression, and residual diagnostics.
detail: Source recovered from the supplied code PDF. The original university tuition dataset is unavailable, so no coefficients or numerical results are claimed. Repository includes the expected schema and steps to run once the input is recovered.

name: Fluoride Treatment Effects
title: Separating treatment and context.
description: Factorial ANOVA workflow for treatment, institution, and changes in DMFT.
detail: SAS GLM analysis includes treatment-by-institution interaction, additive and treatment-only comparisons, adjusted post-hoc tests, and residual diagnostics. The original dataset is unavailable; no numerical findings are claimed.
